name: Browman Mill
summary: Browman Mill is a blighted lumber mill situated just north of Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Once a thriving piece of Lordaeron's timber trade, it now swarms with undead minions under the iron grip of the Scourge. Its former proprietor, Stephen Browman, remains trapped in death within his ruined workshop.

sections.title: A Ruined Industry
sections.body: Before the Third War, Browman Mill served the surrounding towns and homesteads of Lordaeron, processing lumber harvested from the rich forests of the Eastweald. When the Scourge plague rolled across the kingdom, the mill fell alongside the rest of the province. Today, rotting timbers and shattered wheels sit idle while abominations, banshees, and skeletal warriors patrol the perimeter. Its close proximity to Light's Hope Chapel makes it a constant and menacing reminder of the undead horde pressing against the Argent Dawn's doorstep.

sections.title: The Overseer's Fate
sections.body: The mill's original owner, Stephen Browman, met the same grim fate as countless commoners of Lordaeron. Murdered when the Scourge overran the estate, he was raised into undeath as a ravenous ghoul. Stripped of his humanity and enslaved to the Lich King's will, Browman lingers within the dark confines of his former mill, guarding the splintered ruins of his life's work.

faq.answer: Browman Mill is located in the far eastern stretch of the Eastern Plaguelands, sitting directly north of Light's Hope Chapel.

faq.q: What kind of enemies inhabit the mill?
faq.answer: The grounds are infested with Scourge forces, including hulking abominations, wailing banshees, skeletal fiends, and wandering ghouls.
Stephen Browman was the original human owner and operator of the lumber mill. He was slaughtered during the fall of Lordaeron and reanimated as an undead ghoul, bound to guard his ruined building.

faq.q: Why is Browman Mill dangerous to travelers?
faq.answer: Its heavy concentration of powerful undead makes it a lethal hazard, particularly because it sits just a short ride north of the Argent Dawn stronghold at Light's Hope Chapel.

angles.text: The desecrated remains of the mill and the tormented spirits haunting its grounds represent everything the holy orders fight to cleanse from Lordaeron.
Stephen Browman's enslavement is a stark reminder of the fate shared by all victims of the Lich King who were denied the free will won by the Forsaken.
